CVE-2026-126410.description: Wasmtime's wasmtime-wasi crate 48.0.0 before 48.0.8, 49.0.0 before 49.0.5, and 50.0.0 before 50.0.1 contains a time-of-check/time-of-use race in the wasip3 wasi:sockets udp-socket host implementation that lets guests bypass socket_addr_check send restrictions. A malicious guest can race udp-socket.send against udp-socket.connect to deliver attacker-controlled datagrams to addresses the policy permits only for receiving.

CVE-2026-126376.description: Vvveb 1.0.8.4 through 1.0.8.6 contains an incomplete authorization fix that allows low-privilege authors and vendors to access other users' records by bypassing admin_id owner scoping. Attackers can supply filter[admin_id] to list drafts, invoke duplicate() on posts or products, or enumerate every vendor's digital-asset metadata.

CVE-2026-126374.description: Vvveb through 1.0.8.6 contains an SQL injection vulnerability because the @KEYS(:each) macro emits PHP array keys as backtick-quoted INSERT column names without escaping, and several procedures in admin/sql/mysqli/product.sql and admin_auth_token.sql omit the @FILTER guard. Authenticated back-office users able to save products can submit product_<feature> POST array keys containing backticks to redirect bound values into unexposed columns or break SQL statements.

CVE-2026-126367.description: @grpc/grpc-js implements the core functionality of gRPC purely in JavaScript, without a C++ addon. Before 1.13.2, and from 1.14.0 through 1.14.1, the @grpc/grpc-js-xds SafeRegexValueMatcher and PathSafeRegexValueMatcher add start and end anchors without grouping a supplied top-level alternation. An expression intended to match one of several complete values can therefore match a prefix, substring, or suffix. The affected matchers are used for route selection, xDS credential identity matching, and RBAC URL path, principal name, server name, and header rules. An ALLOW policy using an alternation can consequently accept a method, certificate identity, or header value outside the intended set, while a DENY policy becomes broader rather than permissive. This issue is fixed in versions 1.13.2 and 1.14.2.

CVE-2026-126345.description: basic-ftp is an FTP client for Node.js. Prior to 6.2.4, the MLSD directory-listing parser in src/parseListMLSD.ts uses untrusted fact names from the FTP server as keys in the plain-object factHandlersByName dictionary without checking that the resolved property is an own handler. A fact named __proto__ therefore resolves to Object.prototype, bypasses the missing-handler guard, and is called as though it were a function, producing a TypeError. The error propagates through Client.list() and APIs that depend on it because it is not an FTPError. A malicious or compromised FTP server, or an on-path attacker on a plaintext FTP session, can make the affected operation reject, and the Node.js process terminates under the default behavior in Node.js 15 and later only if the application leaves that rejection unhandled. This issue is fixed in version 6.2.4.

CVE-2026-126323.description: Vvveb through 1.0.8.6 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability that allows attackers to perform admin state-changing actions because checkCsrf() in admin/controller/base.php only validates tokens for POST requests. Attackers can lure a logged-in admin into loading a forged cross-site GET request to delete admin/user accounts, sites, orders, and menus or change comment status.

CVE-2026-126301.description: NLTK from 3.6 before 3.10.4 contains an algorithmic complexity vulnerability in LegalitySyllableTokenizer.tokenize that allows remote attackers to exhaust CPU by supplying long all-vowel tokens. Attackers can submit a token such as a long run of vowels, causing the unguarded onset reversal loop to perform quadratic work and deny service to syllabification components.

CVE-2026-126193.description: Soup Sieve is a CSS selector library for Beautiful Soup. From 0.4 until 3.0, deeply nested CSS pseudo-class selectors can cause recursive parsing to exceed Python’s recursion limit and raise  RecursionError . Applications accepting untrusted selectors may experience failure of the affected request or task if the exception is not handled. The demonstrated behavior is recoverable and does not establish an interpreter crash or persistent service-wide denial of service. This vulnerability is fixed in version 3.0.

CVE-2026-126192.description: Soup Sieve is a CSS selector library designed to be used with Beautiful Soup 4. Prior to 2.10, matching a developer-authored selector that places the general sibling combinator inside :has() repeatedly scans each candidate element's following siblings when the right-hand side is absent, producing quadratic work on attacker-controlled HTML. Applications that evaluate a fixed selector such as div:has(a ~ b) over untrusted markup can have a worker occupied for minutes by a small document, while the adjacent sibling form and trusted-only document processing are not affected in the same way. This issue is fixed in version 2.10.

CVE-2026-126189.description: Soup Sieve is a CSS selector library designed to be used with Beautiful Soup 4. Prior to 4.0.1, Soup Sieve repeatedly searches descendant subtrees for each candidate evaluated by :has() and repeatedly reevaluates a parent containing :has(> ...) for each child, causing quadratic matching on deeply nested or wide attacker-influenced HTML or XML. Applications using ordinary fixed selectors through select(), select_one(), or Beautiful Soup CSS APIs against untrusted documents can have a worker occupied for seconds or minutes, while applications that process only trusted documents are not affected. Selectors compiled with NOCACHE continue to use the old uncached behavior. This issue is fixed in version 4.0.1.

CVE-2026-125747.description: ZenTao PMS through 22.7 contains a missing object-level authorization vulnerability in module/build/control.php that allows authenticated users to modify builds in projects they do not belong to. Attackers holding build privileges in any project can supply sequential buildID values to delete, edit, or relink stories and bugs on builds in foreign or private projects.

CVE-2026-125394.description: FreeRDP before 3.33.0 contains a heap use-after-free vulnerability in update_gdi_patblt(), update_gdi_polygon_cb() and update_gdi_mem3blt() that retain stale brush cache pointers. A malicious RDP server can resend CACHE_BRUSH to the same slot then send PATBLT, causing clients to read freed heap memory, disclosing data or crashing.

CVE-2026-125334.description: Forge (also called node-forge) is a native implementation of Transport Layer Security in JavaScript. Prior to 1.4.3, a forge.tls client can pass a handshake record to tls.handleHandshake() while the connection has no session, including after a close_notify alert, after the application calls close(), or before handshake() is called. The handler dereferences c.session.md5 before dispatching the message, causing a TypeError to propagate from connection.process(). A malicious server or on-path attacker can deliver the record, including after a reset when the connection uses no encryption, and terminate a Node.js process if the application does not catch the exception. forge.tls servers are not affected, and there is no confidentiality or integrity impact. This issue is fixed in version 1.4.3.

CVE-2026-125333.description: Forge (also called node-forge) is a native implementation of Transport Layer Security in JavaScript. From 0.1.2 until 1.4.3, forge.http uses _trimString() in lib/http.js to remove trailing whitespace from response header values and cookie names and values with a regular expression that can take quadratic time. A malicious server or on-path attacker can supply a long whitespace run followed by a non-whitespace character in a response header, causing response.readHeader() or response.getCookies() to repeatedly scan the input and block the Node.js event loop or browser tab for minutes. Applications are affected only when they use forge.http with a socket pool to communicate with an untrusted server; forge.http is not loaded by require('node-forge'), and the issue has no confidentiality or integrity impact. This issue is fixed in version 1.4.3.

CVE-2026-125332.description: Forge (also called node-forge) is a native implementation of Transport Layer Security in JavaScript. Prior to 1.4.3, a forge.tls client accepts a ServerHello compression_method that it did not offer. When the client later handles ServerHelloDone, tls.createConnectionState() rejects the unsupported compression algorithm by throwing an Error that propagates from connection.process(). A malicious server or an on-path attacker can alter the unauthenticated ServerHello compression byte before the server Finished message and terminate a Node.js process when the application does not catch the exception. The affected client paths include direct forge.tls use, forge.tls.wrapSocket, and forge.http; forge.tls servers are not affected, and the issue has no confidentiality or integrity impact. This issue is fixed in version 1.4.3.

CVE-2026-124996.description: A weakness has been identified in Turboderp-org ExLlamaV3 up to 1.6.3. The impacted element is the function routing_sel_norm_kernel of the file exllamav3/exllamav3_ext/routing.cu of the component hash-MoE routing. This manipulation of the argument gate.tid2eid causes out-of-bounds read. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. Upgrading to version 1.6.4 is sufficient to resolve this issue. Patch name: c9a57ae832a3035e264e0a412e1daf4ebb699b98. Upgrading the affected component is recommended.

CVE-2026-124624.description: A weakness has been identified in PipraPay 3.0.0. Affected by this vulnerability is the function hash_hmac of the file pp-content/pp-include/pp-adapter.php of the component pp-token anti-CSRF Handler. Executing a manipulation can lead to hard-coded credentials. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

CVE-2026-124031.description: GPAC through 26.07.0 contains a type confusion vulnerability in drawable_get_aspect_2d_mpeg4() and TraverseShape() that casts a Shape's appearance node to M_Appearance without checking its node tag. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT file placing another node type, such as Conditional, in the appearance field to trigger an invalid memory read and crash MP4Box.

CVE-2026-124030.description: GPAC through 26.07.0 contains a type confusion vulnerability in gf_sg_command_apply() in src/scenegraph/commands.c that fails to verify BIFS field-replace command types match target node fields. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT file opened with MP4Box, such as via chapter import, causing gf_sg_vrml_field_clone() to memcpy from invalid pointers and crash.

CVE-2026-123635.description:
Missing Release of Resource after Effective Lifetime vulnerability in elixir-grpc grpc_server allows a client to stall all later calls on a shared HTTP/2 connection via calls that the server refuses while their DATA frames are in flight.

The stream handler grpc_stream_h (grpc_server/src/grpc_stream_h.erl) requests flow from Cowboy only for request data that has arrived. When the server refuses a call early, for example because the body exceeds max_body_size or the method is not implemented, Cowboy drops the DATA frames still in flight for that stream. Their bytes are not returned to the connection flow-control window. After enough refused calls the window is empty. No call on that connection can then send a request body, and each call waits until its deadline. Other connections are not affected.

This issue affects grpc_server: from 1.0.0 before 1.1.0.

CVE-2026-123370.description: compose-lint is a Docker Compose security linter that identifies dangerous misconfigurations before deployment. From 0.9.0 until 0.18.0, compose-lint's YAML parser recognizes lone carriage returns and Unicode line separators U+0085, U+2028, and U+2029 as line breaks while fix position conversion counts only newline characters. A pull request can place one of these separators in a quoted value so fix --apply shifts each later edit and deletes the line after the selected target, including an unselected network or other security setting. The resulting Compose file can remain valid, post-edit checks can pass, and the command can report a successful fix even though the dry-run diff was the only place showing the extra deletion. This issue is fixed in version 0.18.0.

CVE-2026-122056.description: A flaw was found in OpenSCAP. A heap-based buffer overflow can occur when processing a specially crafted Extensible Configuration Checklist Description Format (XCCDF) document using the sds-compose option. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability to corrupt memory, resulting in an application crash and a Denial of Service (DoS).

CVE-2026-116094.description: A vulnerability was determined in EyouCMS up to 1.8.6. This impacts the function remote_file_to_local of the file application/function.php. Executing a manipulation can lead to server-side request forgery. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. Upgrading to version 1.8.7 will fix this issue. Upgrading the affected component is advised.

CVE-2026-113724.description: virtualenv is a tool for creating isolated virtual python environments. Prior to 21.14.9, the safe_delete() deletion error handler responds to a failed removal by reading mode bits with os.lstat(path) and applying owner-write permission with os.chmod(path, ...), which follows a symlink. A planted link inside a read-only directory can therefore cause a victim-owned target outside the destination that is initially not writable by the invoking user to become broadly writable before the retry fails, provided that user owns the target and can change its mode. Another account can use the widened mode only if it can traverse the target's parent directories; root does not reach the demonstrated failure path, and the operation does not itself read the target. This issue is fixed in version 21.14.9.

CVE-2026-113719.description: virtualenv is a tool for creating isolated virtual python environments. Prior to 21.14.9, PipInstall._uninstall_previous_version() accepts existing seed-package metadata and _uninstall_dist() joins entries from top_level.txt and RECORD to site-packages without checking containment. When a reused destination contains distribution metadata influenced by another account, relative traversal, absolute entries, or linked parents can cause app-data reseeding to delete files outside the environment or the environment root with the invoking user's permissions, provided that user has deletion rights over the named paths. The deletion occurs during environment creation before any later use of the environment. Fresh environments without existing package metadata and creation with --clear do not enter this cleanup path. This issue is fixed in version 21.14.9.

CVE-2026-113713.description: virtualenv is a tool for creating isolated virtual python environments. From 21.14.8 until 21.14.10, the app-data seeder can leave an environment linked to temporary package files that virtualenv deletes when creation finishes. The environment-variable and configuration-file forms of symlink_app_data can enable this state even though the command-line flag is disabled for temporary app-data. The resulting environment depends on a cache pathname that its owner no longer controls. This issue is fixed in version 21.14.10.

CVE-2026-112319.description: The GSS-RPC layer in MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) does not enforce size limits on XDR-decoded data, which allows remote authenticated users to cause a denial of service (memory exhaustion or excessive CPU consumption in kadmind) via crafted RPC requests that trigger unbounded memory allocations during XDR decoding.

CVE-2026-112318.description: The policy RPC stubs in kadmin/server/server_stubs.c in MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) 1.5.3 and later do not reject a NULL policy name decoded by xdr_nullstring(), which allows remote authenticated users to cause a denial of service (kadmind crash via NULL pointer dereference) by sending a policy request with an empty policy name that reaches authorization checks or logging code.

CVE-2026-111653.description: 53AIHub before 0.5.5 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to overwrite any enterprise's profile by sending PUT requests to /api/enterprises/:id. Because UpdateEnterprise only enforces checks when IS_SAAS is true, attackers can enumerate sequential enterprise IDs and overwrite logos, display names and branding for defacement and phishing.

CVE-2026-111232.description: Netgate pfSense CE 2.3.0 through 2.9.0 and Plus through 26.07 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated users with Firewall: Rules or NAT: Port Forward privileges to inject scripts via the separator color field. Attackers can submit a crafted separator[] color value that display_separator() renders unencoded into class attributes, executing in administrators' browsers to perform WebGUI actions with their privileges.

CVE-2026-111228.description: Netgate pfSense CE from 2.7.1 through 2.9.0 and Plus through 26.07 contains a CRLF injection vulnerability in services_unbound_advanced.php that allows authenticated users with DNS Resolver: Advanced privilege to inject Unbound directives. Attackers can embed CR/LF characters in the unvalidated sock_queue_timeout parameter, which is written raw into unbound.conf, to override local records and forwarding for all clients.

CVE-2026-111227.description: Netgate pfSense CE through 2.9.0 and Plus through 26.07 contains a CRLF injection vulnerability in services_unbound_acls.php that allows authenticated users with the DNS Resolver: Access Lists privilege to inject Unbound configuration directives. Attackers can embed CR/LF characters in the aclname or aclaction fields written to access_lists.conf to add local-data, local-zone, or forward-zone directives and control DNS answers served to LAN clients.

CVE-2026-106807.description: A denial-of-service vulnerability exists in open5GS v2.8.0 in the PFCP transaction handling path. When the PFCP transaction or timer resource pool is exhausted, ogs_pfcp_xact_remote_create() returns NULL, but the failure is not handled properly and leads to an ogs_assert(new) failure in ogs_pfcp_xact_receive(). An attacker able to send PFCP messages to the affected SMF/UPF can exhaust transaction resources and cause the network function process to terminate with SIGABRT, resulting in service disruption and preventing further session establishment until the affected component is restarted.

CVE-2025-71470.description: MicroQuickJS (mquickjs) before commit 99eed3f contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability because JS_Call() raises exceptions during frame setup without updating ctx->sp and ctx->fp. Attackers can supply JavaScript that calls a non-function value, causing build_backtrace() to walk stale frame pointers and crash the engine for denial of service.

CVE-2025-71466.description: GPAC before 26.02.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in m2tsdmx_update_sdt() in src/filters/dmx_m2ts.c that allows attackers to crash the MPEG-2 TS demuxer. Attackers can supply a crafted .ts file with an invalid service descriptor leaving service or provider names NULL to crash MP4Box and cause denial of service.

CVE-2025-71465.description: @kolkov/angular-editor before 3.0.3 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability in refreshView() that writes HTML from ngModel or reactive form controls to innerHTML without DomSanitizer, bypassing the default sanitize option. Attackers can store HTML with event-handler attributes in content later loaded into the editor to execute script in the application's origin for users opening it.

CVE-2025-71464.description: @kolkov/angular-editor before 3.0.4 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability in toggleEditorMode() that assigns source view text to innerHTML without DomSanitizer sanitization. Attackers can induce users to paste HTML with event handlers such as img onerror into source mode, executing script in the application's origin when toggling views.

CVE-2025-71461.description: Zipline before 4.0.2 contains a predictable filename vulnerability that allows attackers to infer other users' upload filenames by recovering the Math.random generator state. Attackers with five consecutive gfycat-style filenames can reconstruct the random state to predict previous and future filenames until the instance restarts, exposing private uploads.

CVE-2012-10023.description: A stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability exists in FreeFloat FTP Server version 1.0.0. The server fails to properly validate input passed to the USER command, allowing remote attackers to overwrite memory and potentially execute arbitrary code. The flaw is triggered by sending an overly long username string, which overflows the buffer allocated for user authentication.

CVE-2026-97402.description: In Eclipse Kura versions 3.1.0 to 5.6.2, the iBeacon and Eddystone advertisement decoders wrongly parse the AD-structure length field of an over-the-air BLE advertising payload. Any unauthenticated attacker within BLE radio range can broadcast a two-byte advertising payload that drives the Kura beacon-scanner thread into a tight infinite loop, pinning a CPU core and permanently halting beacon ingestion until the gateway is restarted. To trigger the attack, the iBeacon/Eddystone scanner component should be installed and active. By default the components are not installed or enabled.

CVE-2026-76080.description: Probo is a self-hostable governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) platform built for engineering and security teams. Prior to version 0.224.0, the public Trust Center GraphQL API exposes Query.node(id:) with @authentication(required: OPTIONAL) — an unauthenticated internet visitor to any published trust center can call it. Six of its type branches — Organization, Framework, Audit, ThirdParty (subprocessor), TrustCenter, and TrustCenterReference — resolve the object with a tenant scope derived from the client-supplied GID itself (coredata.NewScopeFromObjectID(id)) and load it with a bare Get(scope, id) that performs no comparison to the current trust center's OrganizationID and no showOnTrustCenter/visibility check. (The Document and File branches, by contrast, correctly pass trustCenter.OrganizationID and check visibility). This issue has been patched in version 0.224.0.

CVE-2026-129443.description: A vulnerability was determined in itsourcecode Airline Reservation System 1.0. The impacted element is an unknown function of the file /admin/manage_user.php. This manipulation of the argument ID causes sql injection. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized.

CVE-2026-129358.description: A vulnerability was identified in Linux Foundation Magma up to 1.9.0. Impacted is the function handleReact of the file nms/server/main/routes.ts of the component NMS. Such manipulation leads to cross site scripting. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

CVE-2026-129357.description: A vulnerability was determined in Linux Foundation Magma up to 1.9.0. This issue affects the function hostOrgMiddleware of the file nms/server/host/middleware.ts of the component Host Middleware. This manipulation of the argument role causes missing authorization. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

CVE-2026-129356.description: A vulnerability was found in vllm-project vllm 0.30.0/0.31.0. This vulnerability affects unknown code of the file single_type_kv_cache_manager.py of the component Common Prefix Handler. The manipulation results in race condition. The attack may be performed from remote. Attacks of this nature are highly complex. It is stated that the exploitability is difficult. The exploit has been made public and could be used. Upgrading to version 0.32.0 is able to resolve this issue. The patch is identified as e687a251bb056fa527846633f7a1b0a6c0f42374. You should upgrade the affected component.

CVE-2026-129267.description: A vulnerability was found in sergix44 XBackBone up to 3.8.2. Impacted is the function MediaController::getRawById of the file app/Controllers/MediaController.php. The manipulation results in cross site scripting. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used. The pull request to fix this issue awaits acceptance.

CVE-2026-129264.description: A security vulnerability has been detected in sox_ng up to 14.8.1. Affected by this issue is the function read_samples_voc of the file src/voc.c of the component VOC Decoder. Such manipulation leads to out-of-bounds write. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used. The name of the patch is 0b40408b. A patch should be applied to remediate this issue. The vendor was contacted early, responded in a very professional manner and quickly released a fixed version of the affected product.

CVE-2026-129260.description: A security vulnerability has been detected in Mereithhh VanBlog up to 0.54.0. This vulnerability affects the function fs.readFileSync of the file local.provider.ts of the component Custom Page Handler. The manipulation of the argument path leads to path traversal. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used. Upgrading to version test-20261013 is able to resolve this issue. The identifier of the patch is d63aa163f10b6dc1080e2368fe8e71aa95b765cb. Upgrading the affected component is advised.

CVE-2026-129259.description: A weakness has been identified in Mereithhh VanBlog up to 0.54.0. This affects an unknown part of the file packages/server/src/types/access/access.ts of the component Image Upload Endpoint. Executing a manipulation can lead to cross site scripting. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

CVE-2026-129254.description: A flaw has been found in Opixido OCMS up to b7c15660aba83d96677c1a9abaa69c082a24f21c. This impacts an unknown function of the file admin/TUI/index.php of the component Admin TUI. This manipulation of the argument img causes cross site scripting. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. Continious delivery with rolling releases is used by this product. Therefore, no version details of affected nor updated releases are available. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

CVE-2026-128348.description: ExcelJS through 4.4.0 contains a formula injection vulnerability in the totals row formula getter in lib/doc/table.js that fails to escape [, ], # and ' characters in structured reference column names. Attackers can supply column names containing ] via untrusted input like imported CSV headers to inject formulas such as HYPERLINK that exfiltrate cell values when users open and click the generated workbook.

CVE-2026-128087.description: russh is a Rust SSH client and server library that includes an SSH agent protocol implementation. From version 0.55.0 until version 0.65.1, the initial key exchange invokes client::Handler::kex_done() with the raw shared secret before check_server_key() accepts the server host key or certificate. A malicious SSH server can therefore trigger application-defined secondary-channel initialization or early data handling even when the server identity is subsequently rejected. Ordinary clients that keep the callback's no-op default or independently defer callback-derived actions until trust is confirmed are not affected. This issue is fixed in version 0.65.1.

CVE-2026-127282.product: Smart Attendance System with QR Code Scanner
CVE-2026-127282.description: A vulnerability was determined in SourceCodester Smart Attendance System with QR Code Scanner 1.0. Affected by this vulnerability is an unknown functionality of the file reset_password.php. This manipulation of the argument Username causes cross site scripting. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized.

CVE-2026-127276.description: A vulnerability was identified in Linksys EA8100 1.0.3.216940. Impacted is an unknown function of the component Web UI. Such manipulation leads to cookie without 'httponly' flag. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. This attack is characterized by high complexity. The exploitability is considered difficult. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

CVE-2026-127274.description: A vulnerability was found in Linksys EA8100 1.0.3.216940. This vulnerability affects unknown code of the file /jnap/core/CheckAdminPassword. The manipulation results in improper restriction of excessive authentication attempts. The attack may be performed from remote. The attack requires a high level of complexity. It is stated that the exploitability is difficult. The exploit has been made public and could be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

CVE-2026-127273.description: A vulnerability has been found in Linksys EA8100 1.0.3.216940. This affects the function GetWANStatus/GetWANStatus3/IsAdminPasswordDefault of the component JNAP API. The manipulation leads to missing authentication. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

CVE-2026-127087.description: Ryot before 10.5.6 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to revoke other users' access links by supplying an arbitrary accessLinkId. Attackers can obtain access link ids from public share URLs and revoke them without ownership checks, breaking shared access for all link users.

CVE-2026-126996.description: A vulnerability was determined in SakanaAI text-to-LoRA 0.0.1. Affected by this issue is the function get_tokenizer of the file src/hyper_llm_modulator/utils/model_loading.py of the component Checkpoint Loading. Executing a manipulation of the argument base_model_name_or_path can lead to path traversal. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

CVE-2026-126995.description: A vulnerability was found in tjake Jlama up to 0.8.4/0.9.0-beta. Affected by this vulnerability is the function SafeTensorIndex.loadWeights of the file jlama-core/src/main/java/com/github/tjake/jlama/safetensors/SafeTensorIndex.java. Performing a manipulation of the argument weight_map results in path traversal. The attack may be initiated remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

CVE-2026-126994.description: A vulnerability has been found in braindecode up to 1.8.1. Affected is the function resolve_type_kwargs of the file braindecode/models/util.py of the component Model Config Deserialization. Such manipulation of the argument Activation leads to use of externally-controlled input to select classes or code. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. Upgrading to version 2.0.0 is able to address this issue. The name of the patch is 05b764d93b9a50400f523206fbe03d73d0cf5edb. The affected component should be upgraded.

CVE-2026-126954.description: Glance from 0.7.9 before 0.8.8 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows malicious extension endpoints to inject javascript: URLs via the Widget-Title-URL response header. Attackers controlling an extension endpoint can execute script when users click the widget title, reading dashboard pages through same-origin requests and exfiltrating content.

CVE-2026-126798.description: NextScan 1.1.0 through 1.2.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the ns-admin URL asset detail dialog that renders crawled form request bodies (Asset_URL.data) via innerHTML without encoding. Attackers can host crafted forms on crawled sites to store JavaScript that executes when users view asset details, stealing localStorage access tokens to hijack sessions, including administrators.

CVE-2026-126490.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains active debug code in interface/fax/fax_view.php that executes passthru("groups") and discloses the web server's Unix group memberships. Authenticated attackers with fax module access can supply a nonexistent jid value to reveal groups such as adm or shadow, aiding privilege escalation planning.

CVE-2026-126408.description: Wasmtime 47.0.0 before 48.0.8, 49.0.0 before 49.0.5, and 50.0.0 before 50.0.1 contains an insufficient type-check in the TypedFunc embedder API for I31, Option<I31>, and Option<NoneRef> parameter or result types, reaching an unreachable!() path. A malicious guest module exporting a function that uses another anyref-hierarchy type can panic the host embedding, causing denial of service.

CVE-2026-125751.description: Meteroid before 2.2.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the ApiTokensService GetApiTokenById gRPC handler that fails to apply the caller's tenant context. Authenticated users with settings:read permission can supply another tenant's API token ID to obtain its Argon2 secret hash and owning tenant ID.

CVE-2026-124999.description: A security vulnerability has been detected in braindecode up to 1.8.2. This affects the function EEGModuleMixin._from_pretrained of the file braindecode/models/base.py of the component Hub Integration. Such manipulation of the argument filename leads to path traversal. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used. Upgrading to version 2.0.0 mitigates this issue. The name of the patch is 05b764d93b9a50400f523206fbe03d73d0cf5edb. It is recommended to upgrade the affected component.

CVE-2026-124987.description: A vulnerability has been found in mikefarah yq up to 4.53.3. This affects the function Encode of the file pkg/yqlib/encoder_properties.go. Such manipulation leads to escaping of output. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The pull request to fix this issue awaits acceptance.

CVE-2026-124625.description: A security vulnerability has been detected in PipraPay 3.0.0. Affected by this issue is the function deleteData of the file pp-content/pp-include/pp-functions.php of the component Admin Panel. The manipulation of the argument selected_ids/ItemID leads to sql injection. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

CVE-2026-123372.description: compose-lint is a Docker Compose security linter that identifies dangerous misconfigurations before deployment. From 0.22.0 until 0.32.0, compose-lint substitutes values from a sibling .env file into image fields and quotes the resolved value in CL-0004 and CL-0019 finding messages and fix text. In a workflow that writes secrets into that file and then lints untrusted pull-request content, an attacker can reference a secret variable so its whole value reaches the job log, JSON output, SARIF artifacts, and Code Scanning alerts. Fork pull requests normally lack secrets, so exploitation requires a secret-bearing workflow such as pull_request_target, same-repository branches, or a retained .env on a self-hosted runner, and the pass or fail result is unchanged. This issue is fixed in version 0.32.0.

CVE-2026-123368.description: compose-lint is a Docker Compose security linter that identifies dangerous misconfigurations before deployment. From 0.22.0 until 0.31.0, compose-lint follows a sibling .env symbolic link outside the project without applying its normal containment check. From 0.28.0, the same gap also affects an include project_directory link outside the project. A pull request can reference a variable from the linked file, causing substitution to place runner file or process-environment data into finding messages written to logs, JSON, SARIF artifacts, and Code Scanning alerts. Reading /proc/self/environ can expose the remainder of the linter process environment because NUL-separated entries are treated as one value, although disclosure requires a workflow that processes untrusted changes with useful environment data and GitHub normally withholds secrets from fork pull requests. The pass or fail result is not changed. This issue is fixed in version 0.31.0.

CVE-2026-113717.description: virtualenv is a tool for creating isolated virtual python environments. Prior to 21.14.9, PipInvoke.get_pip_install_cmd() handles --seeder pip --download by calling get_wheel(download=False) and then allowing pip to consult the configured index, bypassing virtualenv's download_wheel() and verify_wheel_digest() path. When virtualenv's default-index PyPI digest comparison remains enabled, an index candidate matching the bundled package and version can therefore be selected without comparison to PyPI SHA-256 metadata. Explicit custom-index settings already opt out of that comparison and remain outside this verification-bypass claim; the demonstrated configuration used a non-PyPI index while leaving the index environment variables unset so the comparison policy remained active. This condition does not independently defeat TLS or establish control of the index response. This issue is fixed in version 21.14.9.

CVE-2026-113715.description: virtualenv is a tool for creating isolated virtual python environments. Prior to 21.14.9, the stdlib venv creator reads generated pyvenv.cfg with str.splitlines() and merges parsed keys over virtualenv's selected configuration. An untrusted caller who influences the destination pathname can include a line-boundary character such as U+2028 to inject keys including home and include-system-site-packages, causing path data to change configuration structure before final output. Setting include-system-site-packages to true weakens environment isolation, while an altered home can change which standard-library files the interpreter loads if the attacker also controls that location. The builtin creator does not use this readback path. This issue is fixed in version 21.14.9.

CVE-2026-113714.description: virtualenv is a tool for creating isolated virtual python environments. Prior to 21.14.9, download_wheel() writes package-index downloads directly into the reusable wheel/house cache before selecting a verification target from pip's textual Saved output. With default-index digest comparison enabled, a controlled package index can inject a misleading Saved line through a discarded link's data-requires-python attribute; this forged-line variant also requires knowledge of an absolute path to the genuine bundled wheel. The wrong path can then be hashed, while a digest mismatch leaves the rejected archive in the cache for later selection without verification. A separate rejected-cache-file variant requires control over downloaded data or archive selection but not the forged-line prerequisites. Explicit custom-index exceptions are outside the promised PyPI comparison, and the issue does not independently bypass TLS or establish control of default PyPI. This issue is fixed in version 21.14.9.

CVE-2026-111233.description: Netgate pfSense CE 2.7.1 through 2.9.0 and Plus through 26.07 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability in firewall_rules.php that allows remote attackers to inject script via the unencoded if parameter. When the non-default Require Firewall Interface option is enabled, attackers can lure users with firewall rules privileges into opening a crafted GET link to execute script in the WebGUI with their privileges.
